messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: automated alert: p99 latency SLO breach detected for inference/redwood-api (us-west-2). p99 = 1.45s (SLO=1.0s). PagerDuty incident PD-8157 created.

pagerduty: Pager PD-8157 fired to on-call rotation -> sam.

sam: acked. pulling logs/metrics now. any obvious deploys?

maria: not seeing deploys in last 30m. traffic spike on model 'gpt-medium-q4' from a single client id 0x4ab3.

sam: ok prioritizing mitigation: 1) temporarily route that client to a lower-cap model, 2) increase replica count for hot pods, 3) enable kv-cache warming. I'll run scale and routing now.

lee: small note — autoscaler is at max for this pool, might need manual scale of dedicated pool or fallback to burst nodes.

sam: running commands:
```
# scale inference pool
kubectl -n infra scale deployment redwood-infer-pool-usw2 --replicas=12
# route rule: client 0x4ab3 -> gpt-small-q4
redwoodctl route add --from-client 0x4ab3 --model gpt-small-q4 --priority temporary
```

sam: scaled to 12, route rule applied. :white_check_mark:

maria: after routing ~30s, p99 dropped to 1.1s but still above SLO. per-token load from client is very bursty (long prompts).

devops-oncall: I'm spinning up 4 burst g4dn instances in the dedicated pool, ETA ~90s. will update when ready.

lee: suggest clearing prefix cache for the hotter shards to avoid KV thrash: `redwoodctl cache flush --shard hot-3`

maria: flushed hot-3 cache.

sam: logs show many requests hitting attention kernel fallback on older CUDA driver, that's adding ~200-400ms. upgrading node driver for burst nodes now.

devops-oncall: burst nodes are up and joined the pool. autoscaler now has headroom.

maria: p99 now 0.92s at 1743201148. SLO restored but we see residual error rate increased: 0.6% 5xx for long-streaming calls. investigating.

sam: leaving PD incident open until 10m of stable SLO. handoff to maria for monitoring. I'll update the incident timeline.

maria: will create a retrospective note, tagging the client and recommending rate-limits / model pinning for them. initial customer impact: degraded latency for ~0.9% of requests in us-west-2 over a 4m window, impacting interactive UX (reports from a partner).

pagerduty: PD-8157 status -> acknowledged by sam, on-call escalation paused.

incident-bot: automated follow-up scheduled in 10m to verify sustained SLO.

lee: postmortem action items: (1) add autoscaler headroom policy for sudden long-prompt bursts, (2) add detection rule for single-client flood to automatically apply temporary rate-limits, (3) validate CUDA driver matrix across burst pool images.

sam: sounds good. closing my active tasks, handing off to maria for the write-up. thanks team :thumbsup:
